fieldNotes.locationStatus: FACILITY NOT POSITIVELY LOCATED. The roster supplies only 'Austell, GA 30168' with an APPROXIMATE geocode (33.777949, -84.574624) that lands on a residential apartment complex / water tower, not an industrial building. Kenco's own warehousing map gives no street address.
fieldNotes.research: Web research strongly suggests this is the former The Shippers Group (TSG) Austell facility - Kenco acquired TSG in January 2024. The TSG Austell facility is documented at 300 Interstate West Parkway, Lithia Springs GA 30122 (off I-20 Exit 44 / Thornton Road): 530,000 SF, 89 dock doors, 20,000 SF cooler space, 39 ft clear - which matches the roster's 'Kenco MCS Georgia I, 540,000 SF, temperature controlled, food grade' very closely. However, satellite probing of the Interstate West Parkway corridor and the Six Flags Road / Riverside industrial park in Austell 30168 did not yield a single positively confirmable 530,000+ SF big-box with legible Kenco signage in available imagery.
fieldNotes.candidates: Two candidate industrial parks were probed: (1) the Interstate West Parkway corridor in Lithia Springs near I-20 Exit 44 - buildings observed were mid-sized multi-tenant; (2) a modern big-box DC park in Austell 30168 around 33.768,-84.580 (Six Flags Road / Riverside area) with several genuine large distribution buildings, but no confirmable Kenco tenancy.
fieldNotes.recommendation: Flagged for human review. Resolve by obtaining the exact street address from Kenco directly, then re-running the deep audit. Most-probable target: 300 Interstate West Parkway, Lithia Springs/Austell GA.
